title: Git & Bundler Basics
intro: Git and Bundler interview questions for Ruby freshers cover the daily workflow tools every developer needs to use from day one. This module covers the git commands every developer runs daily (init, clone, status, add, commit, push, pull), branches and the feature branch workflow, pull requests and what a code review process looks like, .gitignore and what to exclude (.env, tmp/, log/, coverage/), merge conflict basics (how to identify and resolve), Bundler (bundle install, bundle exec, bundle update), the Gemfile (specifying gems with version constraints), the Gemfile.lock (locks exact versions — commit it so every developer runs the same gems), the difference between gem install and bundler in a project context, semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and what ~> 2.5 means), and the .ruby-version file.
